python3 -c "import ast, os, sys, importlib.util
os.environ.pop('ESPALIER_MAINTENANCE_MODE', None)
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
src = open('tools/cc/hooks/_bash_patterns.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
sites = []
for fn in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)):
    if isinstance(fn, ast.FunctionDef) and fn.name != '_scan_and_view_matches':
        for c in ast.walk(fn):
            if isinstance(c, ast.Call) and getattr(c.func, 'id', None) == '_scan_and_view_matches':
                sites.append((fn.name, c.lineno, c.end_lineno, fn.name + ':' + ast.unparse(c.args[0])))
from bench.powershell_reachability_differential import find_powershell
pw = find_powershell()
if not pw:
    sys.exit('no PowerShell: the population is not whole here')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gm_probe', 'bench/guard_metamorphic.py')
gm = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.modules['gm_probe'] = gm; spec.loader.exec_module(gm)
bp = gm._bash_patterns
orig = bp._scan_and_view_matches
seen = set()
def wrapped(rx, scan, view):
    out = orig(rx, scan, view)
    if view != scan and len(out) > sum(1 for _ in rx.finditer(scan)):
        f = sys._getframe(1)
        seen.update(k for n, a, b, k in sites if n == f.f_code.co_name and a <= f.f_lineno <= b)
    return out
bp._scan_and_view_matches = wrapped
rep = gm.check_r4(True, pw[0])
print('sites', len(sites), 'witnessed', len(seen), 'violations', len(rep['violations']), file=sys.stderr)
print(sorted({k for *_, k in sites} - seen))"
